wake_source.responsibility: Start a fresh reasoning invocation at the next supported opportunity.
wake_source.must_not_be_treated_as: proof that predecessor stayed alive or permission for dual substantive authority

reasoning_worker.responsibility: Perform useful checkpointable work while invocation exists.

durable_continuation.responsibility: Persist exact resumable state and side-effect evidence after meaningful units.

supervisor_measurement.responsibility: Detect stale workers, recover/transfer ownership, and measure useful coverage/dead gaps without inference.

scheduler_budget.rule: For a normal ~600s nonterminal CONTINUE turn, arm SAME MAIN once at observed wake/arm reference +660s and normally do not mutate it mid-turn. Extend once before collision only if useful authorized work or close handling clearly threatens that due. Normal close shifts SAME MAIN to exact END+60. If that occurrence is lost before bootstrap, the SAME MAIN recurring RRULE supplies the natural hourly cold fallback. Watchdog is not required.

startup_receipt_generation_fence.rule: A BOOT_STARTED receipt is valid only for the scheduler generation whose generation_key exactly matches boot_started_authority_epoch. A stale receipt from an earlier occurrence cannot satisfy current startup acknowledgement.

predictive_prearm.purpose: Hide scheduler delivery latency under predecessor useful work.

conditions: useful admissible work remained or fallback continuation was required
no terminal or safe continuation/transfer evidence exists
response: do not infer useful work across the gap
recover at next available verified wake
if repeated, target wake/runtime adapter rather than adding policy prose

rolling_recovery.startup: minimum fence, persist generation-matched BOOT_STARTED, arm and verify SAME MAIN +660s provisional, then classify normal vs predictive vs recovery before substantive authority
rolling_recovery.normal_close: checkpoint then live-verify SAME MAIN END+60; do not arm Watchdog
rolling_recovery.mutation_failure: retry once when safe; if older verified future continuation survives, classify DEGRADED_CONTINUATION within its safety envelope; otherwise fail closed before conflicting substantive side effects
rolling_recovery.stale_occurrence: classify a natural SAME MAIN recurrence after missing bootstrap as MAIN_COLD_FALLBACK_RECOVERY; recover forward without replacing the canonical

time_unit_safety.rule: Human-readable timing must include explicit units; critical relay timings include both human unit and exact seconds. Bare END+60/NOW+180/+660 forms are forbidden.
